# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B22

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

The metadata sheet records that the power channel is signed so that charge-direction power flow produces positive numbers.
Because current was never logged, the distinction between measured and placeholder values does not arise.
The data dictionary specifies that the time counter never resets within a test and accumulates continuously.
Documentation refers to power samples without declaring the trigger set.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The declared unit for the voltage channel is mV.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the temperature records is verified using exclusively: completeness_counter.
Because the recording is not segmented by cycle index, the question of how indices are recovered does not apply.
Within the dataset the charge/discharge state is determined by: step_type_column, separate_state_column, mode_code_enum.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B22 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B22.
